work.text: Trading orders. A miner posts long, short or flat signals on forex, crypto, equities or commodities pairs into a simulated account whose size is set by deposited collateral in Theta, Taoshi's token. Validators book the orders against live prices with fees and slippage. What is paid for is the account's realized profit in dollars, week by week.
work.quote: Miners can submit LONG, SHORT, or FLAT signal for Forex, Crypto, Equities, or Commodities trade pairs into the network during market hours.

scoring.text: Debt-based. Each week, ending Sunday 00:00 UTC, a miner's realized profit above its own prior high-water mark, in USD, times a penalty multiplier for drawdown, risk profile and minimum collateral, minus unrealized losses, becomes a payout the network owes. Average daily PnL carries 100 percent of the score; Calmar, Sharpe, Omega, Sortino and t-statistic are computed at weight 0.0.
scoring.quote: "Needed payout" = Cumulative earnings from activation through end of previous pay period (PnL in USD * penalties)

split.text: Proportional to debt owed. Each miner's weight is its remaining weekly payout in USD divided by the emission projected, in USD, over the days left to Sunday. Every eligible miner also gets a dust floor: one unit in challenge period, two on probation, three in main competition. If the debts sum to less than the emission, the excess weight goes to burn UID 229.
split.quote: If sum < 1.0: assign (1.0 - sum) to burn address (uid 229 mainnet / uid 5 testnet)

judges.text: Twelve validators were active on the 2026-09-09 chain snapshot. Commit-reveal is on. A validator is the exchange: it receives every order, prices it from live feeds, charges fees and slippage, keeps performance, penalty and emission ledgers in 12-hour checkpoints, runs plagiarism and elimination checks, and recomputes weights every five minutes. Nothing is sampled; every order is booked.
judges.quote: commit_reveal_weights_enabled True, weights_rate_limit 100, max_validators 64; chain-2026-09-09.json active_validators 12

cadence.text: Emission settles every 360 blocks, about 72 minutes. The payout period is a week, Sunday 00:00 UTC to Sunday. Ledgers checkpoint every 12 hours and weights refresh every 5 minutes. A new registration is immune from deregistration for only 1,200 blocks, about 4 hours, against the 5,000 most subnets use; the challenge period itself runs 61 to 90 days.

buyer.text: Two kinds. Traders pay Vanta Trading, Taoshi's prop-firm front end, a one-time evaluation fee, $14 for a $5,000 account up to $599 for $100,000 with a 100 percent reward split, and are paid weekly if they pass. The network's own page says the protocol A-books the best strategies into real capital. No figure for capital deployed or signals sold appears in text.

exploits.text: Copying another miner's orders: a follower detector compares order streams over a 10-day lookback at 2-minute resolution, flags similarity above 0.75, and elimination follows a two-week review. Eliminated hotkeys are permanently blacklisted. Recovering a loss earns nothing, since payout is gated on the high-water mark. A 1 percent floor on volatility blocks gaming the Sharpe denominator. Drawdown of 5 percent intraday or 8 percent end-of-day eliminates.
exploits.disagrees: The README at the pinned commit gives one drawdown rule for all miners, 5 percent intraday or 8 percent end-of-day, while docs/miner.md in the same repository says challenge-period miners are eliminated at 5 percent end-of-day and only main-competition miners at 8.
